# Diagnosis contract

Record target ID/version/hash, environment, symptom, expected behavior,
reproduction steps, raw traces, last-known-good version, hypotheses, tests,
root-cause evidence, mutation authority, repair candidate, rollback and recovery
checks. Redact secrets and hidden reasoning; preserve observable tool and state
transitions.

Repair only a reproduced defect. Route healthy metric improvement to
`agent-optimizer`, mission/permission/topology change to `agent-refactor` or
`agent-architect`, teams to `agent-team-manager`, and platform failures to the
responsible Agentic OS skill.
